                // Ensure autoplay is set to 0
                if (src.indexOf('autoplay=1') !== -1) {
                    src = src.replace('autoplay=1', 'autoplay=0');

                    src += (src.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'autoplay=0';

                iframe.attr('src', src);

                let allow = iframe.attr('allow');
                if (allow && allow.indexOf('autoplay') !== -1) {
                    allow = allow.replace('autoplay;', '').trim();
                    iframe.attr('allow', allow);
                }
            }
        };

        // MutationObserver to watch for dynamically added iframes
        const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
                if (mutation.addedNodes.length) {
                    $(mutation.addedNodes).each(function() {
                        if (this.tagName === 'IFRAME') {
                            const iframe = $(this);

            });
